notes.title: Minor Fixing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Optimized the logic of the chess game to make the enemy AI a little smarter.
[*] Fixed scene background errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Fixing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the error of the enemy's chess moves in the chess game.
[*] Fixed the occasional error report of bullet array after battles.
[*] Adjusted the performance of [bullet dash] and [knock down] in time-slowing effect.
[*] Fixed the cooldown error on the skills.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Fixing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where players would get stuck when loading from the first scene to another scene without talks.
[*] Fixed the problem that the cost for reviving overflowed after the player died many times.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Content Optimization Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The "time-slowing" buff mechanism has been reworked. Now players themselves will not be affected by the time-slowing, and a special screen effect has been added.
[*] Increased the HP of Fuxi boss in hard mode, and modified the display of her health bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Game optimization and problem update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that the NPC might get stuck in the wall after the owner boss fight.
[*] The player's bullets can shoot down enemies in the air now.
[*] Player can dash to the nearst enemy with the [in-air Bullet] ability. Now the player can pursuit monsters in the air, which saves player's time in chasing monsters on ground.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Fixing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added guidance when the player enters the store.
[*] Fixed the problem of sound effect errors during the Minesweeper game.
[*] Fixed the error that the player's [Flash Attack] ability would target Yan Yin's boss underwater.
[*] Fixed a bug where some players did not have music during the Yunxing boss battle.
[*] Fixed the problem that the [Teleport Smash] ability did no damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Fixing Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that some NPCs disappearing in the plot and the game could not be continued.
[*] The contrast of the snowflake screen transition animation is reduced.
[/list]

notes.title: Game optimization update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Optimized the key conflict problem of some of the Gamepad mapping, and added the Gamepad mapping in the lower right corner of the memory scenes
[*] Increased the damage range of some of the player's in-air skills
[*] Added slight self-targeting effect to the player's [Shoot] skill
[*] Fixed the problem of some English line spacing errors
[/list]

notes.title: GamePad Keymap Configuration Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The gamepad keymap options can be selected in the setting page.
[*] Fixed a problem with the player's ability-unlocking error in the aftergame.
[*] Increase invincibility time when player revives.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Game difficulty update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of monsters to be brushed in the ordinary difficulty of the game.
[*] It adds plot difficulty to the game. Players can directly click the green button at the top right corner of the screen in the plot mode to open the built-in cheat device of the game.
[*] Add guidance tips in the game.
[/list]
